title: fix: quest boards without admins; home and community colours
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Quest leaderboards and monthly standings exclude admins, and the voodoohop-only quest rules from #16875 were removed. The Community contributors list ranks the top 20 accounts by merged PRs across the six latest monthly news files, combining entries by account ID; bots remain eligible and receive an Agent badge. Home and Community received updated card colours and badges, a Quest Pollen sprout, tinted publish cards, and clearer stat labels. @pollinations/ui 0.1.0-alpha.11 adds IconTile colour options and places display StatCard labels below their numbers in the matching colour. Service Providers links were removed from the footer and mobile menu, but remain in Privacy and Terms.

image.prompt: Polli studies a cozy pixel-art quest board with a Pollen sprout beside a retro computer showing a colourful contributor list; tiny flowers grow around the desk. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings. She wears tiny reading glasses, stays small-to-medium within the scene, and is strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green (#ecf874), warm cream, and dark purple (#110518) accents.
